playstyle.identity: Zilean is a time mage who revives allies with his ultimate. He provides insane utility with speed-ups, slows, and his double-bomb stun.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: gives bonus XP to allies. Q places a time bomb (2 bombs on same target stun). W reduces Q/E cooldowns. E speeds ally or slows enemy. R puts an ally in stasis - they revive if they die. Double-bomb for stun, R to save carries.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Zilean spikes at level 6 with revive and with CDR for double-bomb. Shurelya's adds utility. He's strong at protecting carries.

passive.name: Time in a Bottle
passive.summary: Store experience; grant it to level up allies.
passive.details: Zilean stores experience over time. He can use it to level up a nearby ally champion.

abilities.name: Time Bomb
abilities.summary: Place a bomb that detonates after a delay; 2 bombs stun.
abilities.details: Zilean places a time bomb that detonates after a few seconds. Placing two bombs on the same target stuns when the first detonates.

abilities.name: Rewind
abilities.details: Zilean reduces the cooldowns of Time Bomb and Time Warp.

abilities.name: Time Warp
abilities.summary: Speed up an ally or slow an enemy.
abilities.details: Zilean bends time around a target. Allies are sped up; enemies are slowed.

abilities.name: Chronoshift
abilities.summary: Put an ally in stasis; if they die, they revive.
abilities.details: Zilean places a protective time rune on an ally. If they die within a few seconds, they enter stasis and revive with health.
